purpose: Single backend contract for admin-managed asset/product badge tags stored on media_assets.tags.
ownedRules: Asset tags normalize to uppercase enum tokens using A-Z, 0-9, hyphen, and underscore only.
Asset tags are limited to 40 characters each, which leaves room beyond current merchandising labels while preventing storefront badge overflow.
A media asset may carry at most 16 tags.
Tags are deduplicated in insertion order before persistence or API response serialization.
databaseContract: V19__asset_tag_contract.sql mirrors the same max length, max count, and token regex at PostgreSQL level.
